request: an SVG animation of a pelican riding a bike
thesis: A pelican is all beak and pouch and a bike is all circles; the joke and the charm are the pelican's wrong-shaped body doing a bike's job, with legs that pedal and a pouch that bounces.
job: open the page and see a pelican on a bike already moving
watch the wheels spin, legs pedal, pouch bounce, scenery scroll
see it keep going without running down

tricks: group with transform-origin set in fill-box so rotation pivots right
spokes as rotated lines in one group
tests: squint: is it a pelican on a bike
each moving part has its own pivot

steps: offset body bob at twice pedal rate
tricks: compute leg IK in JS from crank angle so feet stay on pedals
head and pouch lag the body by a few ms
pause via flag not removing loop

expectations: clearly a pelican not a duck

kinds.name: side-view cartoon pelican on a road bike, scrolling countryside
pelican on beach cruiser at sunset

descriptions: bill is about as long as the head plus neck
pouch sags and swings under the bill
body leans forward on the saddle
rear wheel drives, both wheels equal
crank rotates once per pedal cycle, pedals counter-rotate to stay level
behaviors: wheel rotation speed matches ground scroll speed: angle = distance / radius

descriptions: scenery scrolls left so bike appears to move right
three parallax layers at 0.1, 0.3, 1.0 of speed
pause button label toggles and motion halts

anti_keywords.not: a duck-like round body with a short bill
anti_keywords.instead: an exaggerated bill and drooping pouch

anti_keywords.not: wheels that spin but legs that stay still
anti_keywords.instead: feet pinned to pedals via leg IK
scrolling parallax scenery tied to wheel rotation

anti_keywords.not: CSS transform-origin default at 0 0 on SVG
anti_keywords.instead: explicit pivots in JS or transform-box fill-box
pause and speed that visibly change state

checks: Is it recognisably a pelican on a bike at a glance
Do feet stay on pedals through the full cycle
Does pause stop everything and play resume
built: side-view cartoon pelican on a road bike, scrolling countryside
